items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Ernie called me the other day... I just tell him, 'Keep healthy; you'll make just like you want.'

ctx.x: And incidentally, Ernie Andrews just made a record on it, put it on an album. I have to get you a copy of it.
Yeah, I'd love to hear that. So how did the title get changed?
